recognize_zh: 低倍（A、B）見瀰漫成片、單調的小至中型細胞完全取代組織結構；高倍（C、D）細胞核細緻染色質、核膜不規則或扭曲（convoluted），伴隨許多核分裂與凋亡碎片，符合淋巴母細胞淋巴瘤（lymphoblastic lymphoma）。
features: Diffuse, monotonous sheets of small-to-intermediate cells effacing the tissue architecture (A, B)
High N:C ratio with scant cytoplasm
Finely dispersed (blastic) chromatin with small inconspicuous to variably visible nucleoli
Numerous mitotic figures and apoptotic debris (C)
Delicate intervening vasculature without nodular or follicular architecture
describe_en: Sections show a biopsy with complete effacement of the architecture by a diffuse, monotonous infiltrate extending to the capsular edge. At high power, the infiltrate consists of small-to-intermediate cells with scant cytoplasm, irregular to convoluted nuclear contours, finely dispersed chromatin and small nucleoli. Mitotic figures and apoptotic bodies are frequent. No follicular architecture or significant polymorphous inflammatory background is identified. Findings are consistent with lymphoblastic lymphoma; immunohistochemistry (TdT, CD34, CD1a, cytoplasmic CD3, CD19/PAX5) is required to confirm T-lineage.

ddx.vs: B-LBL is morphologically indistinguishable and is separated by PAX5/CD19/CD79a positivity and lack of CD3 on immunohistochemistry.
Burkitt shows medium-sized cells with round nuclei, clumped chromatin, multiple small nucleoli and a starry-sky pattern, and is TdT-negative with MYC rearrangement.
Blastoid MCL is TdT-negative and cyclin D1/SOX11 positive with CD5 and CD20 expression.

ddx.dx: Thymoma (type B/AB) with abundant immature T cells
ddx.vs: Thymoma contains a keratin-positive epithelial meshwork and lacks sheet-like destructive growth beyond lobules.
